about.title: About Montreal Concierge Services | Professional Cleaning & Property Management
about.description: Learn about Montreal Concierge Services - 10+ years of professional commercial cleaning, property management, and Airbnb concierge services across Montreal & Riviera Sud. 500+ satisfied clients.

hero.title: About Montreal Concierge Services
hero.subtitle: Professional concierge services and commercial cleaning on the Riviera Sud since 2014. We serve businesses, property owners, and Airbnb hosts with excellence and reliability.

story.title: Our Story & Mission
story.paragraph1: Founded in 2014, Montreal Concierge Services started with a simple vision: to provide professional-grade concierge and cleaning solutions to businesses and property owners in the Riviera Sud region. What began as a small team has grown into the most trusted name in commercial cleaning and property management across Montreal's South Shore.
story.paragraph2: Today, we're proud to serve over 500 satisfied clients, from small offices to large commercial complexes. Our commitment to excellence, reliability, and attention to detail has made us the go-to choice for Airbnb management, office cleaning, and residential property services across Montreal and surrounding areas.
